Input from the community has been vital in guiding the park's development, as part of a larger effort to expand public outdoor spaces across Texas.

india.title: Howard Stern's wife Beth turns grief into rescue mission, helping over 2,000 cats find homes

This center improves the conditions for cats waiting for adoption and boosts rescue capabilities. With over 2,000 cats fostered since 2013, Beth's dedicated efforts have played a crucial role in spotlighting the importance of adopting shelter animals nationwide.

india.title: Farm Becomes Wildlife Retreat: Olivia Newton-John reshaped Dalwood estate; sale tied to cancer work
india.summary: Olivia Newton-John owned a country estate in Australia that she transformed over nearly four decades. This property included natural features and a significant amount of wildlife habitat that she developed. After battling cancer, the estate was sold in 2019 for $4.6 million, reflecting changes in her priorities. Newton-John's connection to the area continued through her involvement with a wellness retreat she co-founded.
